CORE COMPETENCIES

PROFILE SUMMARY

Monitoring

Bloomberg, JIRA & Service Now

A hardworking and adaptable lead with more than a decade of experience in Risk & Compliance and Capital Market domain.  Experienced in Project Management, successfully transition new process and migrated new controls within surveillance.

 Control Testing & FRD Drafting, Calibration and UAT Testing

 Designing / Operating Efficiency Testing,

Reporting Data Issues and Enhancements

Worked extensively on various market conduct applications including SMARTS, Trading Hub MAST, Actimize focusing on identifying market risk across different assets classes, optimizing threshold and reporting escalations.

 Trade Life Cycle – Custodial Operations,

Securities Settlement & Breaks Monitoring

 Trader – Equity, FI, Derivatives & FX

Strong understanding of Capital Market Operations / Trade Life Cycle with exposure of working in front, middle and back office.  Able to work under pressure with demonstrated history of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Trading and Confirmations

 Team Handling and Training & Development

 AI Tools & Prompts - Copilot / Stylus

Received multiple performance awards and hold strong leadership skills with effective communication and eager to learn new things.

CURRENT ORGANISATIONAL EXPERIENCE

Compliance Manager

Citicorp Services India Private Limited – 22/05/2022(DOJ) – till date  As part of ICRM team, have worked in multiple projects including migration of new country under market risk jurisdiction. Migrated multiple in-house modules on new surveillance platform; performed UAT testing, alert optimization & running calibrations in order to enhance current control framework and reduce noise as part of compliance testing.

Conducted control testing for surveillance division, helped team in FRD’s creation and drafting procedures. Reported considerable suggestions and parameter changes basis regulatory requirements. Participated in monthly calls and presented reports discussing risk & issues with country compliance.

Proactively worked with internal stakeholders, country compliance leads, data quality teams and traders to report meaningful observations as issues, improving visibility to system gaps & potential risk areas which further facilitated effective collaboration within team and ensured timely enhancements on risk management tools and platforms.

Proactively initiating brain storming session within team on timely manner in order to identify areas of development. Provided trainings to new member on control environment in terms of investigating alerts across different market conduct behaviors with the help of surveillance tools and reporting breaches.

Identified areas of operational improvements while working in collaboration with multiple teams to streamline the flow of accurate data into the system. With experience keeping abreast understanding of the risk and control environment, embedded thresholds and limitation of alert generation.

Conducted multiple risk management reviews as part of 1st line of defense and effectively escalated observations to 2nd line of defense. Created prompts to interact with in house AI tools to be used for alert review process.

Proactively manage team productivity, workflow and ensure works being done within stipulated time line and quality

parameters as per regulatory standards and internal policies & procedure.

PREVIOUS EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Assistant Manager

HSBC Electronic Data Processing (India) Private Limited – 10/09/2020(DOJ) – 24/04/2022(LWD)  Worked as part of Regulatory Compliance team and provided a wide compliance service in the areas of Trade Surveillance across assets classes. Proactively participated in UAT testing for newly on boarded surveillance tool – Trading Hub MAST.  Investigating alerts on Market abuse, Information boundary, Staff dealing approvals etc. Review and escalate alerts generated by the Global Market Surveillance System - Trading Hub, Actimize and Actone; that may signify potential risk to company and / or its clients on different assets classes.

Performed monitoring controls such as calibrations & threshold changes. Managed work allocation & MI reporting on periodic basis and ensured risks within the team are mitigated. Assisted team in the initial set up and drafting of review steps and procedure manuals.

Have identified multiple data issues and coordinated with technology team in order to streamline flow of data in surveillance system. Reported measurable gaps & potential risk areas which further facilitated effective collaboration within team and ensured timely enhancements on risk management tools and platforms

Participated in monthly calls discussion with onshore counterparts to highlight risks & issues within the team, if any. Providing trainings to new team members and assisting them on their queries.

Specialist

State Street HCL Services India Private Limited - 07/06/2019(DOJ) – 04/09/2020(LWD)  Worked as part of Global Custody Operation and completed process transition of Trade Settlements within stipulated time.  Worked on DTCC Platform and processed Trade Settlements for different types of trades like Repo trades, IFTB, Depo trades

of Equities and Fixed Income securities. Reviewing STP process, processing unmatched trades.

Working as an SME to draft standard procedure document. Approving/Failing/Rejecting broker deliveries after proper

investigations within market cut off.

Researching and retrieving specific security or fund information from the available source to verify breaks in trades and

reaching to respective parties to amend the trades.

Reporting failing trades to Investment Manager or Broker in order cancel/rebook trades to process settlement. Reporting

volumes to process mangers and allocating the work within team.

Providing training to new associates on the basics of capital market and process flow.

Advisory Lead

Karvy Stock Broking Limited - 05/10/2015(DOJ) – 03/06/2019(LWD)  Worked as part of compliance advisory team in margin monitoring, audio & email monitoring. Tracked daily intraday trading limits and quantified Value-at-Risk (VAR) impact for PMS clients, ensuring immediate escalation to senior management.  Monitored real-time regulatory requirements, collateral coverage, and leverage limits and made sure same was implemented

timely into firm’s internal servers/ terminals. Reporting end of the day report to regulators.

Investigating and resolved formal queries from exchanges regarding anomalous trading activity, price spurts, and order-to- trade ratios. Reporting fat-finger errors in timely manner and ensuring the same recorded in brokers books as per procedure.  Proactively managed team of advisors in trading floor and acted as dealer in placing orders for clients in Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, Currency and Mutual Fund segment on trading platform as part of portfolio management for HNI clients.

Managed work allocation & team's productivity on different parameters in order to meet team’s monthly targets. As part of quality control check, monitored advisors calls on regular basis and provided feedback at EOD on areas of improvement.  Effectively communicated business requirements to relationship managers and worked extensively in order to improve new client acquisition and portfolio/fund transfers. Build reports and presented monthly data to advisory head on periodic targets.  Experience in resolving claims/complaints of clients. Identifying trade deviations, if any, collecting required data and forwarding the same for trade reconciliations.

PROJECTS UNDERTAKEN

Project Title 1 UAT Testing for Migrated Modules

Company

Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.

Duration

September 2025 – December 2025

Details: Acted as pioneer UAT team member in the alert migration project. Contributed significantly to the successful validation and optimization of the new surveillance framework. Demonstrated strong ownership by proactively engaging in early stage testing of alert logic and data flows during migration phase. Provided actionable observation to manager and product owners improving visibility to system gaps & potential risk areas which further facilitated effective collaboration across stakeholders and ensured timely enhancements to the alert design and configuration. The identification of improvement opportunities in alert calibration helped refining trigger logic and filter mechanism which directly led to reduction in false positive alerts

Project Title 2 Surveillance Modules for New Market

Company

Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.

Duration

6 Months (July 2024 to January 2025)

Details: Played a key role in onboarding new markets into surveillance scope and successfully integrated new modules which significantly expanded monitoring coverage. Actively coordinated with technology and data science teams to define and discuss additional requirement contributing to alert enhancements and reducing false positive alert. Actively collaborated with internal stakeholders & traders to gain a deeper understanding of client business models and trading behavior, supporting more accurate client categorization and risk profiling which further contributed to the preparation of Watch list and Restricted list in terms of enhancing control framework.

Project Title 3 US Settlement Process Migration

Company

State Street HCL Services

Duration

3 Months (November 2019 to Jan 2020)

Details: Acted as a SME in procuring the US Trade Settlement process from client ensuring seamless transition within timelines and minimal operational disruption. Driving end to end process knowledge transfer, have supported team in preparing SOP’s to ensure standardization and sustainability. Conducted multiple training sessions for analyst enhancing team readiness into BAU operations. Served as an active point of contact for migration and related queries and periodically reported developments to process managers.

CERTIFICATIONS

 AML Transaction Monitoring and Suspicious Transaction Reporting (TMSTR)

 NISM Series Xlll - Common Derivative Examination

 Diploma in Financial Accounting System (Tally 9)

ACADEMIC DETAILS

 MBA in Finance - Received Gold Medal for Academic Excellence from Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, Bhubaneswar

Completed on 01/06/2015

 Bachelor of Commerce with Accountancy Honours, KD College of Commerce & General Studies, Midnapore.

Company

Details: Acted as pioneer UAT team member in the alert migration project. Contributed significantly to the successful validation and optimization of the new surveillance framework. Demonstrated strong ownership by proactively engaging in early stage testing of alert logic and data flows during migration phase. Provided actionable observation to manager and product owners improving visibility to system gaps & potential risk areas which further facilitated effective collaboration across stakeholders and ensured timely enhancements to the alert design and configuration. Project Title 2 Surveillance Modules for New Market
Company
Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.
Duration
6 Months (July 2024 to January 2025)

Project Title 3 US Settlement Process Migration
Company
State Street HCL Services

3 Months (November 2019 to Jan 2020)
Details: Acted as a SME in procuring the US Trade Settlement process from client ensuring seamless transition within timelines and minimal operational disruption. Driving end to end process knowledge transfer, have supported team in preparing SOP’s to ensure standardization and sustainability. Conducted multiple training sessions for analyst enhancing team readiness into BAU operations. Served as an active point of contact for migration and related queries and periodically reported developments to process managers.
